specs.Other Special Features of the Product: Ergonomic, Lightweight, Portable, Programmable Keys, Stylish Design

features: ➽ Ergonomic & Durable Design: Stylish, ergonomic design with a compact Nano Receiver. Built for long-lasting use and ideal for both home and office environments. Compatible with Microsoft Windows and Mac OS.

➽ The keyboard is highly durable lifecycle of 10 million keystrokes for heavy usage of keyboard. It is specially designed for Indian Region with Indian Rupee ₹ & US Doller $ key codes for business computing. Easy to connect USB connectivity for use with multiple operating systems.

➽ Fast Scroll Wireless Mouse has 10 m Working Distance, has Swicth Life of 3 million clicks and Equipped with 2.4 GHz Frequency. It is highly durable design for the user comfort and navigation convenience. It features Plug and play connectivity with USB dongle.
➽ The Wireless Keyboard has Membrane Switch, it comes with 104 Chicklet Keys. The Wireless Mouse has Optical Sensor and Adjustable DPI (800/1200/1600)
➽ The Wireless Keyboard and Mouse Combo includes 1 AA Battery (Keyboard) and 1 AA Battery (Mouse). Warranty: The product has One Year Carry-in Warranty.
